New Extension Area (Approx. 430 SF)

-Ensure footing elevations are set to receive slab edge forms and maintain level bearing surfaces.

-Strip formwork and clean up footing areas after concrete has cured sufficiently.

ItemName: Slab Edge Forms / Shallow Foundation Walls Construction
Description:
New Extension Area (Approx. 430 SF)

-Furnish and install slab edge formwork or shallow stem walls around the perimeter of the slab-on-grade foundation.

-Form edge heights to align with finished slab elevation and maintain proper step-downs.

-Supply and install reinforcement (horizontal rebar and vertical dowels from footings).

-Provide form ties, corners, and control joints as required for structural integrity.

-Supply, pour, and finish concrete for slab edges or shallow foundation walls.

-Supply and install anchor bolts or embedded hardware into top of walls to secure future wall framing.

-Strip forms after curing and clean work area.

New Extension Area (Approx. 430 SF)

-Prepare subgrade inside foundation perimeter by verifying compaction and elevation of granular base material.

-Supply and install a minimum 4" thick compacted crushed stone or gravel base across the entire slab area.

-Supply and install 6 mil polyethylene vapor barrier over the stone base, properly lapped and sealed at seams.

-Furnish and place slab reinforcement (e.g., welded wire mesh or rebar) per structural design.

-Provide sleeves and block-outs for underslab plumbing, electrical, and mechanical penetrations.

-Supply, pour, and finish 4" thick reinforced concrete slab with hand-trowel or power-float finish, per specifications.

Description:

-Supply and install OSB or plywood wall sheathing and apply weather-resistive barrier with flashing at all openings.

-Insulate exterior wall cavities with R-21 batt insulation and seal all joints, penetrations, and framing gaps per energy code.

-Supply and install drywall on interior face of all exterior walls to Level 4 finish, ready for paint.

New Roof Extension

-Frame new walls using 2x6 wood studs, securely tied into existing rafters and ceiling joists.

-Supply and install new rafters, ridge beam, jack rafters, and ties as required for structural support.

-Sheath walls and roof with exterior-grade plywood or OSB.

-Supply and install roof sheathing over the entire roof area with exterior-grade plywood or OSB.

-Supply and install synthetic underlayment membrane over all roof surfaces for weather protection.

-Flash and trim connections, roof edges, and penetrations with metal flashing as required.

-Supply and install roof insulation within the dormer wall and roof cavities per code.

New Extension Area

-Include all siding accessories such as starter strips, J-channels, utility trim, and finish strips.

-Cut and fit siding neatly around all window and door openings, and utility penetrations.
